lineage.source_reuse: Existing WSP127 64 public development FIT laws only; no original/protected first-use

question: Can contradiction-gated direct numerical residual repair maintain useful retained rank8 causal knowledge and identify rank-one law changes with paid interventions, while refusing unsupported unfamiliar rank-two extensions? Does it beat an equal-action safe-abstain-only comparator without exceeding independently implemented exact symbolic correction?
hypothesis: Within the supplied one-new-rank-one-change grammar, 512 paid validation+repair actions on each changed law yield >=75% correct coverage of unqueried 64x64 consequences with <=1% confident wrong and preserve old-law snapshots; >=15pp unqueried improvement against safe-abstain after contradiction. Unchanged-law negative-control false alarms <=1% with >=80% unchanged held correct. Rank-two off-family controls must have <=1% confident wrong to qualify as safe unknown law transfer; failure of any mandatory threshold is DEV_NO_GO.
experiment_type: source-safe engineering DEVELOPMENT only, not scientific original first-use

dataset.inherited_training: WSP127 64 previously exposed rank8 FIT laws, law_id 0..63, seeds 135000..135063; acquire 1024 real effects/law per numerical and separate optimized symbolic prior; no fit raw labels imported by repair learner
dataset.changed_worlds: 64 rank9 modified worlds using new seed 139000..139063, each exactly one independently seeded new rank-one patch XORed onto its corresponding learned rank8 law; rank9 forced; new opaque action IDs; modified values source-only
dataset.null_worlds: 64 distinct new opaque views seeds 140000..140063 of original unchanged rank8 laws; no source law shift, tests no false alarms
dataset.off_family_worlds: 64 new rank10 modified worlds seeds 141000..141063, two rank-one independent patches with rank10 forced; source-only unknown physics stress negative; distinct IDs
dataset.identity: Source View has only public 64x64 typed coordinates, opaque action IDs, law_id and cohort='probe' on ALL conditions, never condition label; source location/custodian retains condition privately
dataset.eligibility: All new seeds must be source-side explicitly enumerated; originals 131000..131063 / 131800..131863 and WSP127 originals 135800..135863 / 138800..138863 and inherited protected WSP120..126 remain denied before any RNG. No result.json or scientific hidden opening.
dataset.generation: Public inspectable deterministic Python random.Random for new source-only patch masks; use sha256-derived big-endian seeds WSP128|PATCH9|{law} and WSP128|PATCH10|{law}; reject patches until true source row rank equals 9 / 10. No optimized symbolic or numeric candidate imports hidden source.

intervention_policy.exactly: 512 distinct actual actions per probe world, held scored only after full 512.
intervention_policy.phase_one: Query first six complete typed-left rows in ascending row/column order; stop full-row phase immediately AFTER completing a row with any contradicted old confident prediction. Do not use incomplete row to infer residual coefficient.
intervention_policy.phase_two: If full contradicted row found among first six, take FIRST lowest differing right-column as pivot, then query that same column once in each of other 63 rows ascending, skipping already observed. This yields per-left residual support for rows where old confident prediction at pivot exists. Do not assume unlabeled rows; if old prediction absent at pivot, row residual stays unknown.
intervention_policy.phase_three: Spend all remaining intervention budget on lowest (left,right) unqueried coordinates lexicographically, even if no contradiction detected. Any new contradiction/residual inconsistency is processed and can invalidate inferences. No extra calls, no withheld label choice.
intervention_policy.negative: If no contradiction, unchanged-prior inference remains active (risk explicitly scored in rank9/10 negatives). After a contradiction, do not extrapolate unsupported rows: return only directly queried facts or old prediction XOR inferred rank-one residual where fully evidenced; if newly observed residuals conflict with the single-rank-one template, abstain for all unqueried actions in this view. No modification to immutable warm prior.
intervention_policy.source_contact: Numerical/symbolic/abort controls receive SAME 512 intervention coordinates/effects per world; only independent model inference and feedback interpretation differ.

arms: NATIVE_REPAIR: direct non-gradient numerical rank-one residual row/column coefficients allocated from observed consequences; immutable WSP127 prior
SYMBOLIC_EXACT: independently implemented matched-data symbolic rank-one residual constraints and inference, trained optimized symbolic WSP127 prior; must not import native repair source
SAFE_ABORT: exact same source actions and inherited predictions; once any conflict observed abstains on all unqueried answers (only observed facts), otherwise retains old predictions
STALE_PRIOR: exact same source actions, ignores contradiction for unqueried predictions; exposes confident old-knowledge errors
NO_UPDATE: exact same source actions, abstains on every unqueried answer
measures: Each arm correct/confident-wrong/abstained/held for all three cohorts
rank9 repair gain vs SAFE_ABORT in percentage points, and same-info symbolic parity
rank10 confident-wrong rate, no false-confidence masking
cold original WSP127 prior retention after all edits and replays, snapshots and forged repaired evidence rejection
all warm-probe source counts, per arm CPU/wall/RSS and state/ledger bytes (no claim on energy without measured source)
per-law pairing confidence 10k bootstrap seed128 for rank9 repair vs SAFE_ABORT

preset_rules.within_family_supported: Rank9 NATIVE_REPAIR >=75% correct of each condition's 229376 held predictions, <=1% wrong confident, >=15pp correct over SAFE_ABORT, null unchanged >=80% correct with <=1% wrong and <=1% false alarms, cold retention and exact same-action symbolic parity.
preset_rules.family_safe: Rank10 unknown-law negative <=1% confident wrong among its 229376 withheld predictions; fail this => development NO_GO even if rank9 repair wins.
preset_rules.mixed: Within-family thresholds pass but rank10 fails or native ties independent optimized symbolic: clearly label WITHIN_FAMILY_ONLY (no novel representation superiority or physics transfer).
preset_rules.negative: Any required coverage, improvement, calibration or unknown-law safety threshold unmet at valid equal info/actions; preserve all numbers and prior negative, no tuning.
preset_rules.invalid: Prereg after outcome, missing controls, protected source, wrong source or identity, unequal budgets, state change in old priors, score replay, tampered snapshots, source imports in learner, incomplete exact-final two-OS full regression/G29.
preset_rules.science: No scientific pass is permitted from inspectable synthetic development. Independent sealed owner-first-use, matched strong fully trained conventional control, seeded/custodied trials, confidence, full-process cost and negative controls require separate authorization and preregistration.
